description: This file contains implementation of snapshot and screenshot matchers for testing, including classes and functions for comparing images and buffers, handling file paths, and managing snapshot states within the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: SnapshotHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing snapshot and screenshot comparison, file paths, and result generation.

methods.name: toMatchSnapshot
methods.description: Matcher function to compare a buffer or string against a stored snapshot, with support for updating snapshots.

methods.name: toHaveScreenshot
methods.description: Async matcher function to compare a page or locator screenshot against a stored image, with options for style, clipping, and updating snapshots.

methods.name: toMatchSnapshotStepTitle
methods.description: Generates a step title string for snapshot matching based on provided name or options.
